RPM, checksum list and Git commit are unsigned.
Embedded preparation-time records still say audit pending; completed audit results are external attachments.

Synthetic GUI inputs initially caused repeated characters, repeated dialogs and an overlong-filename save error; the test process was stopped and image import/save passed in a fresh GUI using mouse confirmations.
